sentence: I drove my daughter to school every morning last week.
synonym: I took my daughter to school
synonymNote: take someone to a place 表示送某人去某处，意思相同

distractors.word: I walked my daughter to school
distractors.note: walked表示步行，而drove是开车，交通方式不同

distractors.word: I sent my daughter to school
distractors.note: sent表示发送或派遣，不表示亲自开车送

distractors.word: I picked my daughter up from school
distractors.note: pick up表示接回，方向相反，不是送去学校
